name: freestruct-shapes
description: File checks over a docs site baked by the freestruct post-render SEO layer. The engine stamps one buildHash on every page and on every cache-bust param; this pack holds that contract: one freestruct-build across the tree, every ?v= equal to the build hash, no head tag doubled by a cache-hit rebuild (the missing-only gate), canonicals absolute and on one origin (the sub-path basePath contract), and the 404 pipeline contract (#11: a 404 gets noindex plus the full pass). Zero network, zero HTML execution - attribute reads only.
